definitions.explanation: Songs written for or sung by children. Includes traditional nursery rhymes and modern children's songs.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{童謡|どうよう}を{歌|うた}っている。
examples.english: The children are singing nursery rhymes.

examples.japanese: 「{赤|あか}とんぼ」は{有名|ゆうめい}な{日本|にほん}の{童謡|どうよう}だ。
examples.english: "Aka Tombo" (Red Dragonfly) is a famous Japanese children's song.

examples.japanese: {童謡|どうよう}を{聴|き}くと{懐|なつ}かしくなる。
examples.english: Listening to nursery rhymes makes me feel nostalgic.

notes:
USAGE: {童謡|どうよう} specifically refers to songs for children. Japanese nursery rhymes often have seasonal themes and are associated with childhood memories.

FAMOUS JAPANESE CHILDREN'S SONGS:
・{赤|あか}とんぼ (Red Dragonfly)
・{春|はる}が{来|き}た (Spring Has Come)
・{ふるさと} (Hometown)
・{七|なな}つの{子|こ} (Seven Children)
・チューリップ (Tulip)
・{浜辺|はまべ}の{歌|うた} (Song of the Seashore)

HOMOPHONE:
・{動揺|どうよう} (agitation, disturbance) - same reading, different meaning

RELATED WORDS:
・{子守|こもり}{歌|うた} (lullaby)
・{歌謡曲|かようきょく} (popular song)
・{唱歌|しょうか} (school song, anthem)
